title_en: A Supplication of Vigil and Remembrance

meta.attributed_to: Layout fixture — not an attributed text
meta.occasion: The last third of the night
meta.purpose: Proving facing-column row alignment on real OCR bytes

preamble_en:
This file is a LAYOUT FIXTURE for the supplication print lane. Its Arabic lines are verbatim Azure Doc-Intelligence OCR output from a real vocalised Arabic scan, so the renderer is exercised against genuine tashkeel-bearing bytes rather than hand-typed text.

Every petition is DISTINCT. Exactly one line — the closing invocation — recurs, so the derived refrain rule (a unit is a refrain if and only if its source repeats verbatim) has precisely one thing to find. The units deliberately mix very short against very long so row alignment, the vertical rule, and per-row break-inside avoidance are all visible.

It is not a devotional text and must never be published as one.

units.source: وَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَكَ
units.english: And in part of the night, keep vigil with it as a work of supererogation for you.
Then surely the Garden — that is the abode.
The noblest of you in the sight of God is the most God-fearing of you.

units.source: آَوَ لَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِيِ اْلاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا
units.english: Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked?
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
So turn away from whoever turns his back.

units.source: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلاً
units.english: Truly those who believe and do righteous deeds — for them the Gardens of Paradise shall be a welcome, a lodging prepared for them, in which they shall abide and never seek to be removed.
And they shall not be wronged in the least.
I shall show you a remembrance of it.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
Whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work.
And whoever does righteous work — those shall enter the Garden.
And in the hours before dawn they sought forgiveness.

units.source: وَلَوْ اَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ اِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ
units.english: Had they been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.

units.source: خَلَفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلَوةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ
units.english: A generation who neglected the prayer and followed their appetites.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
